title: Qualify for the Boston Marathon
claims: The 2027 Boston Marathon is scheduled for 19 April 2027 and the 2028 Boston Marathon for 17 April 2028.
The 2026 qualifying standards are identical to the 2027/2028 table and were announced on 16 September 2024, five minutes faster for athletes under 60.
2027/2028 standards, age 18-34: men 2:55:00, women 3:25:00, non-binary 3:25:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 35-39: men 3:00:00, women 3:30:00, non-binary 3:30:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 40-44: men 3:05:00, women 3:35:00, non-binary 3:35:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 45-49: men 3:15:00, women 3:45:00, non-binary 3:45:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 50-54: men 3:20:00, women 3:50:00, non-binary 3:50:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 55-59: men 3:30:00, women 4:00:00, non-binary 4:00:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 60-64: men 3:50:00, women 4:20:00, non-binary 4:20:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 65-69: men 4:05:00, women 4:35:00, non-binary 4:35:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 70-74: men 4:20:00, women 4:50:00, non-binary 4:50:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 75-79: men 4:35:00, women 5:05:00, non-binary 5:05:00.
2027/2028 standards, age 80 and older: men 4:50:00, women 5:20:00, non-binary 5:20:00.
Qualifying times are based on official submitted net time (chip time) and must be run on a certified full marathon course.

Only certified outdoor full marathons with transponder timing and at least three officially entered competitors are accepted; indoor, virtual, treadmill, time-trial and handicapped marathons are not accepted.
Athletes must be at least 18 years old on race day; runners are not officially entered until their qualifying time is verified.
Qualifier registration for the 2027 Boston Marathon ran from Monday 14 September 2026 10:00 a.m. ET to Friday 18 September 2026 5:00 p.m. ET and was not first-come, first-served.
The qualifying window for the 2027 Boston Marathon began on 13 September 2025; the window for 2028 began on 19 September 2026.
The qualifier registration cut-off for acceptance into the 2027 Boston Marathon was 5 minutes 17 seconds below the age/gender standard.
About 1,000 qualifiers not faster than the cut-off are randomly selected through the Boston Qualifier Selection; acceptance notifications go out by early October.
Starting with 2027 registration, net-downhill courses of 1,500-2,999 ft receive a +5:00 adjustment, 3,000-5,999 ft a +10:00 adjustment, and 6,000 ft or more are not accepted for qualifying.
The non-accepted qualifier history continues: 2023 0:00 (0 not accepted), 2024 5:29 (11,039), 2025 6:51 (12,324), 2026 4:34 (8,887), 2027 5:17 (8,019), each with a 30,000 or 31,500 field.
Meeting the qualifying standard only permits submitting an application; field-size limits mean not all qualifiers are accepted, with the fastest in each age/gender group admitted first.
